problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Cargo A: volume 62 cubic meters
* Cargo B: volume 33 cubic meters
* Cargo C: volume 40 cubic meters
* Cargo D: volume 38 cubic meters
* Cargo E: volume 38 cubic meters
* Cargo F: volume 60 cubic meters
* Cargo G: volume 32 cubic meters
* Cargo H: volume 63 cubic meters
* Cargo I: volume 32 cubic meters
* Cargo J: volume 65 cubic meters
* Cargo K: volume 70 cubic meters
* Cargo L: volume 54 cubic meters
* Cargo M: volume 41 cubic meters
* Cargo N: volume 52 cubic meters
* Cargo O: volume 67 cubic meters
* Cargo P: volume 35 cubic meters
* Cargo Q: volume 35 cubic meters
* Cargo R: volume 65 cubic meters
* Cargo S: volume 41 cubic meters

Each plane can carry up to 100 cubic meters of cargo. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes. Each shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total volume on any plane cannot exceed its capacity.
